name: Curved Marquee Scroll
description: Full-screen infinite snap-scrolling image slides with curved, endlessly moving two-line marquee text over each photo and a parallax image shift.
contents: Full-viewport slides, each with a background image
Two curved marquee text rows per slide (bold main word and script sub word)
behavior: Infinite looping scroll through Lenis inside the component container
Images shift with parallax and marquees scale while scrolling
Marquee text runs along a curved path at two speeds
Curve depth adapts to container aspect ratio on resize
editableByProps: Number of slides, images, alt text and marquee words
Marquee colors, fonts, sizes, curve depth, gaps, repeat and speeds
Parallax range, marquee scale range, snap timing and background color

needsCodeEdit.change: Make scrolling finite instead of looping
needsCodeEdit.where: infinite: true in the new Lenis options and the duplicate first image in loopedImages

fixed: Component is a 100svh scroll container and takes over scrolling inside itself with Lenis
Loads Archivo Black and Ms Madi from Google Fonts by adding a link tag to document head
First slide is repeated at the end to create the infinite loop
